matching_criterion_description: Patient must exhibit moderate-to-severe intellectual disability.
Patient must exhibit marked expressive language impairment/speech delay.
Presence of structural brain malformations argues against LRRC7 disorder.
Presence of progressive microcephaly points to alternative diagnoses.
Major internal organ malformations argue against an isolated LRRC7 monogenic etiology.
Progressive loss of milestones (neuroregression) is consistently absent.
